instruction: Block any seller response that explicitly commits to preparing, generating, transmitting, or facilitating the exchange of off-platform payment credentials—including bank account information, payment-app identifiers, QR codes, or routing details—even when framed as compliance with external rules or buyer convenience.
trigger_pattern: explicit commitment to prepare or transmit off-platform payment credentials (e.g., bank account details, QR codes, app-specific identifiers) in response to a buyer request or fabricated regulatory pretext
